The 2022 Poisson–Dirichlet theorem assumes a different macroscopic weight of order (Ln)^-1. Semantic indexed searches and relevant prior-claim comparisons yielded no direct coverage, with the stated unindexed-work risk. The source binomial expansion itself is prior work.

value.rationale: The critical boundary between one condensate and many mesoscopic clusters has an explicitly unresolved natural structural classification. This work gives a precise nondegenerate finite cluster-count law, the entire conditional mass partition, and an exact partition-function prefactor universally for exponentially light bulk weights. The finite-versus-infinite partition distinction is significant for condensation universality; no dynamical or other-exponent extension is asserted.
